summary: The v2 Audit gate removed the v1 KG over-classification and detected all four target gap classes, but the unchanged Patch builder converted only one target relation into an accepted answer-eligible edge. Patch construction quality violated mandatory gates.

primary_results.details: Audit detected CH02 qualifier loss, CH06 calculation-to-classification, CH12 qualified monitoring/CDD results, and CH47 action-references-experience.
CH03-S02 and CH05-S04 produced zero gap claims and no additions.

primary_results.result: 4 accepted, 1 pending, 7 rejected out of 12 new edges
primary_results.details: Only the CH47 REFERENCES target relation was fully repaired among the four original target gaps.

regressions.baseline: High-risk assessment statement did not provide an explicit institution subject
regressions.variant: Audit supplied a financial-institution subject and Patch generated a rejected PRECEDES edge

regressions.baseline: P7D v23 had 9 rejected edges across 52 total edges
regressions.variant: P7D v2 had 11 rejected edges across 43 total edges; 7 of 12 newly added edges were rejected

issues.variant: Audit correctly found both gaps, but Patch reused an initial-investigation process that did not support the new target bases; both replacement edges were rejected

issues.baseline: Calculation and threshold comparison lacked UBO classification output
issues.variant: Audit found the gap, but Patch attached the result to a broader existing process; P7D retained the edge as pending inference rather than accepted

issues.baseline: CDD and monitoring result qualifiers required faithful representation
issues.variant: Audit found the claims; one monitoring result was accepted, but three result edges were rejected because target labels omitted can-help/helps-ensure qualification

issues.baseline: Scenario-setting REFERENCES historical experience was missing
issues.variant: The REFERENCES edge was accepted; an unnecessary passive restatement PRODUCES edge was rejected

next_action: Freeze the v2 Audit outputs and run a patch-only experiment. Change only the Patch prompt to require qualifier-preserving target labels, exact source-process evidence, new process nodes when existing nodes do not match, no active/passive duplicate exits, and unresolved output when the claim invents a subject.
